captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of two rectangular pieces: a bottom case and a matching lid, positioned side-by-side. The bottom case features a hollow rectangular interior with a recessed inner ledge along its upper rim to receive the lid. The lid is also hollowed out with a corresponding outer lip designed to nest securely inside the case's recessed rim, creating a flush, interlocking closure.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, two-part rectangular utility box consisting of a case and a matching lid. The box must have adjustable internal dimensions (width, length, and height) controlled by parameters 'x', 'y', and 'z', and feature interlocking step joints along the rims to allow the lid to fit securely onto the case.
captions.factory: The script defines two distinct parts using boolean difference operations on cube primitives. The first part (the lid) is constructed by subtracting a smaller inner cavity cube from a larger base cube, followed by subtracting a wider, shallow cube at the upper boundary to create an internal recessed rim. The second part (the case) is translated along the X-axis and is created by subtracting an inner cavity cube from its base cube, and then using a nested difference to subtract a outer border cube, leaving an elevated rim that fits into the lid's recess.
